description.value: Cannon Estate Winery is a family-owned estate winery opened in 2022 on 20 acres in the Mt. Lehman area of Abbotsford, producing French-style terroir-focused wines under the Cannon and The Wick labels. The property includes Calibre by Cannon, a lounge offering sit-down dining, weekend brunch, and regular live music, making it a destination rather than a simple bottle shop. Located 10 minutes north of Highway 1, it sits in the heart of the Fraser Valley wine country and is a natural stop on rural cycling routes through the region.
